commits.message: Edges are judged on the bytes written and only after a glyph; a cell's style reads its cluster's start (rich-control-codes-xh4n.s60)
An edge drops only zero-cell extenders, control text is still sealed, and cluster edges are segmented once (rich-control-codes-xh4n.s60)
Snapped spans are the one reader of a cell's style; an edge drops every opening extender (rich-control-codes-xh4n.s60)
A span edge inside a grapheme cluster stops mattering, and nothing joins across a segment edge (rich-control-codes-xh4n.s60)

groff's overstrike on a wide character decodes, pinned on its bytes (rich-control-codes-xh4n.u53) (#555)

* groff writes a wide character's overstrike as mandoc does, and decodeAnsi is pinned on it (rich-control-codes-xh4n.u53)

* The groff note says what it read and where it stops (rich-control-codes-xh4n.u53)

* The groff note names the switch that selects overstrike, and pins the redraw it describes (rich-control-codes-xh4n.u53)
